question.text: The amphoteric oxide among $\mathrm{V}_2 \mathrm{O}_3, \mathrm{~V}_2 \mathrm{O}_4$ and $\mathrm{V}_2 \mathrm{O}_5$, upon reaction with alkali leads to formation of an oxide anion. The oxidation state of V in the oxide anion is :

solution.text:
$\mathrm{V}_2 \mathrm{O}_5$ is amphoteric oxide.
$\mathrm{V}_2 \mathrm{O}_5$ gives $\mathrm{VO}_4{ }^{3-}$ on reaction with alkali oxidation state of V in $\mathrm{VO}_4{ }^{3-}=+5$
